title: LegislationObject
description: One file of a piece of legislation. schema.org types LegislationObject as both Legislation and MediaObject, which is the FRBR work/expression split that ELI and Akoma Ntoso both rely on: the Legislation is the law, a LegislationObject is a particular rendering of it. The same law may have an authoritative signed PDF, an Akoma Ntoso XML marked up for machines, and an unofficial HTML reading copy - legislationLegalValue is what says which is which.

encodingFormat.description: IANA media type. Use application/akn+xml for Akoma Ntoso.

legislationLegalValue.description: Real schema.org LegalValueLevel enumeration. Consumers use this to pick the citable text rather than guessing from the file extension.

conformsTo.description: The document standard this file follows, e.g. the Akoma Ntoso namespace URI.
